rows.related_cases: HCJ 2257/04 Hadash-Ta'al Faction v. Chairman of the Central Elections Committee for the 17th Knesset, PD 58(6) 685 (8.8.2004; Barak, Mazza, Cheshin, Beinisch, Rivlin, Procaccia, Levy): petition accepted; the Knesset's term is four years from its election (s. 8 of Basic Law: The Knesset); the chairman's determination placing the next elections in 2007 set aside; the gap created by Amendment No. 8 interpreted, the amendment not attacked. Barak criticised the hasty drafting.
